note: Weak check on the world side: Reuters/AP not readable, so a world event absent from the events list means not determined. As in earlier files, ct24 and ctk count as lists for non-Czech events too, and a Reuters/AP citation inside a Wikipedia entry counts as list (b). The planning file was prepared 9 Nov 18:38-20:20 CET. Many missed Czech items are same-day statements or decisions (Mlsna's clearance, Sviták, sectoral taxes, canteen standards) that no sweep could have caught; Havlíček's Ukraine business mission (announced in advance) is the one sweep gap. Accidents, crime and disasters are recorded for transparency though excluded by policy.

events.title: Abu Dhabi: second day of US-Russia-Ukraine talks; Medinsky says a large prisoner exchange is agreed; Witkoff and Kushner to meet Putin in Moscow on Thursday and Zelensky in Dublin

Prague: leaders of STAN, Spolu and Praha sobě confirm their coalition; Hlaváček to be mayor, council line-up next week
European Parliament debates the situation of Czech public-service media; Commissioner McGrath says Czech law must ensure adequate, sustainable and predictable funding
